title: Arsonist Tweaked
description: Tweaks the arsonist armor from the aerial hell mod to make it fit in more with the vanilla armor
body:
# What?
Changes the arsonist armor set to fit in more with the vanilla ones. Changes both the model and the item textures. 

# Why?
Was originally made because my friends and I thought it looked a bit weird and didn't really fit as the default armor. 

# When?
Was originally made for the 0.7.4.2.1 version of the mod but I think It should work fine on other versions.
